title: Pubnet system event executable_update from a contract that replaces its own Wasm
why: A contract that calls update_current_contract_wasm makes the host publish a SYSTEM contract event, not a CONTRACT one: topics `executable_update`, the old and the new executable as vectors, and an empty vector as data. Readers that only handle contract events, or that expect token-style topics, skip or misparse it.
notes: Chosen with the locate index of the full pubnet scan (token `X|ev|op:INVOKE_HOST_FUNCTION#ev=SYSTEM:sym:other:n=3-4:VEC`): among the ledgers that hold the shape, the one with the smallest lake object. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture. `expect.values` are written by hand from the decoded sidecar; participants, state changes and movements are the reference extractor's output, checked against the sidecar.

values.note: Old executable, then new; data is an empty SCV_VEC, not void.
The new Wasm hash the call passed in is the third topic's hash.
